question: Which of the following pairs of musicians and their instruments is INCORRECT?
solution:
The correct answer is **__K Vaidyanathan – Sitar.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kunnakudi Vaidyanathan** was an Indian** classical music violinist and music composer.**
 
• **Pandit Ram Narayan** is a Hindustani classical musician who plays the bowed instrument, the **sarangi**. 
 
• **Ustad Vilayat Khan **was an Indian classical **sitar player.**
 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan** used to play **Shehnai**.

 
• **Hence K Vaidyanathan – Sitar pairs of musicians and their instruments is INCORRECT.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan (1916 – 2006)** (Real name is Qamaruddin Khan), was an Indian musician credited with popularizing the Shehnai.
 
• He was felicitated with several awards including:
 
 
• Padma Shri in 1961
 
• Padma Bhushan in 1968
 
• Padma Vibhushan in 1980
 
• Bharat Ratna in 2001
 
 
 
• **Ustad Vilayat Hussain Khan** of the Agra Gharana composed bandishes in many ragas under the pen name Pran Piya.
 
 
• Ustad Vilayat Hussain Khan was born in 1895.
 
• Vilayat Khan received his early training in Hindustani classical music from his father Nathan Khan.
 
 
 
• **Pundit Ram Narayan**
 
 
• ​He is a Hindustani classical musician who plays the bowed instrument, the sarangi.
 
• He is credited with popularizing the sarangi as a solo classical instrument.
 
• He was born in 1927 in Amber village in Rajasthan.
